origins.name: Farmhand
origins.description: Years in the fields built strength and a feel for growing crops.

origins.name: Wanderer
origins.description: Long journeys taught you to travel light and keep moving.

origins.name: Apprentice
origins.description: Workshop errands gave you a little practical knowledge.

origins.name: Street Urchin
origins.description: Keeping out of sight was often the easiest way to survive.

origins.name: Soldier
origins.description: Long watches and short rations were your share of soldiering. Drill taught you to hold a line; the first real battle taught you to keep your guard up. The uniform is gone, but the habits remain.

origins.name: Gunner
origins.description: From a battered turret above the gate, you learned to judge distance and wait for a clear shot. A crossbow served when the road took you beyond the walls. You still count your bolts before your cats.

origins.name: Assassin
origins.description: Your old employer paid for quiet work and asked few questions. You learned to follow a mark, wait in the dark, and strike before they could raise an alarm. Leaving that trade has not made sleep any easier.
